inlines.v: PO'TENT, adjective [Latin potens.] Powerful; physically strong; forcible; efficacious; as a potent medicine. Moses once more his potent rod extends. 1. Powerful, in a moral sense; having great influence; as potent interest; a potent argument. 2. Having great authority, control or dominion; as a potent prince. PO'TENT, noun A prince; a potentate. [Not in use.] 1. A walking staff or crutch. [Not used.]
